description: This file defines the class MidiOutputPortConnectionSelector, which manages the selection and connection of MIDI output ports to a destination input port, including handling user interaction and resource management.

classes.name: MidiOutputPortConnectionSelector
classes.description: A class extending MidiPortSelector that facilitates selecting a MIDI output port and connecting it to a specified destination device and port, handling user interaction and resource cleanup.

methods.name: MidiOutputPortConnectionSelector
methods.description: Constructor initializing the selector with MIDI manager, activity context, UI spinner ID, and destination device info and port index.

methods.name: onPortSelected
methods.description: Handles the event when a port is selected; establishes a connection to the device port.

methods.name: onClose
methods.description: Cleans up resources by closing the MIDI port connector.

methods.name: setConnectedListener
methods.description: Sets a listener that responds when ports are successfully connected.
